subject: V10R3 eval gate application hardened on Draft PR #84
body: Lane B independently reproduced the 4c99bfef binding repair: normalized committed-text bindings match, focused protocol verification passed, and the V10R2/V10R3 unit sweep passed. Hostile review then found that the existing V10R3 evaluator emits candidate NLL and case losses but does not itself apply the frozen per-family mean-loss regression gate. Lane B added a CPU-only fail-closed gate helper on work/v10r3-eval-gates-lane-b-20261004-v1 at 52ebad3ccc6315c1f7496f358df72e89ac248f2a, Draft PR #84. It binds train SHA, panel record-ID SHA, and runtime binding before computing continuous-minus-staged token-weighted NLL and worst family mean-case-loss regression. Focused evaluator tests 6/6 PASS under Python 3.12.10; V10R2/V10R3 suite 78/78 PASS under Python 3.14.5. Training may continue under the existing lease, but raw eval completion alone must not be treated as the prospective recipe-semantics decision; apply the frozen NLL and family gates with this helper or an independently equivalent calculation.
